request.style: English, male solo voice with deep resonance, harp, tin whistle, bodhran, fiddle, cello, solemn and majestic, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Solomon had twelve district governors over all Israel
Who supplied provisions for the king and his household
Each one was responsible for one month of the year
In the hill country of Ephraim Ben-Hur stood
Ben-Deker in Makaz and Shaalbim
Ben-Hesed in Arubboth and the land of Hepher
Ben-Abinadab in all of Naphath Dor
Baana son of Ahilud in Taanach and Megiddo

[Chorus]
Geber son of Uri in the land of Gilead
The country of Sihon king of the Amorites
And of Og king of Bashan
He was the one governor over that land

[Verse]
Ben-Geber in Ramoth Gilead with Jair's settlements
The region of Argob in Bashan sixty large cities
With walls and bronze bars on their gates
Ahinadab son of Iddo in Mahanaim
Ahimaaz in Naphtali married a daughter of Solomon
Baana son of Hushai in Asher and Bealoth
Jehoshafat son of Paruah in Issachar
Shimei son of Ela in Benjamin

[Chorus]
Geber son of Uri in the land of Gilead
The country of Sihon king of the Amorites
And of Og king of Bashan
He was the one governor over that land
